policy: Full unpruned model resident in GPU or unified memory, including lookup tables. Weights are shared across concurrent sessions. Exclude expert/lookup disk streaming and sub-4-bit compression. Memory and cost are planning estimates, not verified throughput or vendor quotes. Explicit user-approved model_overrides may use other quantization or disk-backed tables; their source notes describe the exception.
notes: Parameter thresholds are the approved fallback. Planning memory allowances are coarse reference capacities, not cost-to-memory quotations. Detailed resident memory can raise a fallback tier. Concurrency is a budgeted session count with nominal cache allowance; no latency or tokens-per-second promise is made. The high-end tier has no capacity ceiling: its actual node count and cost remain workload-dependent. Kimi K3 (2.8T total parameters, native MXFP4) is the high-end example.

deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.quantization: EXL3 approximately 2.9–3 bpw, with disk-backed native Engram tables
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.notes: User-approved ≤S$25k two-Spark override based on community local-serving recipes using approximately 2.9–3-bit quantization and disk-backed Engram tables. Exception to the default 4-bit/all-resident fallback. Total parameter count remains 748B; saved full-resident memory research is preserved separately and does not describe this configuration. One 108K-token session is budgeted in this chart tier. Recipe performance and quality are reported by the authors, not independently reproduced; the original AAII score is not verified for this quantized deployment. Cost is an indicative SGD band, not a vendor quote.
